Employee Benefits With Paychex Insurance Agency

Managing employee benefits can involve plan selection, enrollment, administration, employee questions, and ongoing support. In this video, see how Paychex Insurance Agency combines benefits consulting with Flock Benefits Administration in Paychex Flex to support employers and employees. The demo highlights enrollment-status tracking, employee insurance elections, tutorials, and access to a dedicated account manager and support team. You can also explore additional Paychex Flex demos or review broader Paychex employee benefits solutions for additional options and services.

Paychex Insurance Agency Benefits Consulting

0:01 Looking to elevate your company's benefits but don't have the time to manage it all? Paychex Insurance Agency can help. One of our licensed agents will guide you through hundreds of carriers to find the benefits package that's right for your business.

Compliance Analysis and Risk Reduction

0:15 And they’re backed by a whole team of compliance analysts who stay on top of complex regulations to help reduce your risk.

Flock Benefits Administration in Paychex Flex

0:22 Plus, you’ll have access to Flock Benefits Administration within Paychex Flex, making benefits accessible and easy to manage for employees and administrators.

Benefits Dashboard and Enrollment Tracking

0:33 Admins can track enrollment status and see how benefits are being used through a convenient benefits dashboard.

Employee Enrollment and Intuitive Workflows

0:40 Employees can manage all their benefit elections such as health, life, and disability insurance, thanks to Flock's intuitive workflows. Spanish translations, pop up suggestions, in-app tutorials, and videos help them enroll at their own pace.

Dedicated Account Management and Support

0:57 And if you ever have a question, you can count on our support team and your dedicated account manager for a personalized answer. Flock makes your job easier whether you employ five people or 5,000. To learn more about how Paychex Insurance Agency can help you, contact us today.
